summary: Frontend-only retest of (1) 3-level Browse category tree and (2) X-mystery symbol plain-English rendering. Both features verified working end-to-end via real Playwright on the public preview URL. Also verified /characters page and ClauseText chips handle X-variants without crashing, and unit-verified plottoSymbols.js (renderPlainEnglish/resolveCast/extractSymbols) against real plotto.json data via node.

issues: Backend now returns b_heading for every conflict but the frontend never displays it (grep for 'b_heading' in /app/frontend/src returns nothing). Cards and /conflict/:id still show only the subcategory, so a user cannot see which B-heading (masterplot) a conflict belongs to unless they drilled the rail. Consider showing it as a breadcrumb on ConflictDetail.
Summary text 'his son, SN' keeps a raw un-chipped 'SN' (data uses bare SN, not SN-A), so it renders as plain text while all other symbols get chips. Cosmetic/data nit, pre-existing.

action_items: Optional: surface b_heading in the UI (conflict card meta and/or ConflictDetail breadcrumb) — it is fetched but unused.
Optional: chip bare 'SN' (and similar suffix-less family symbols) in ClauseText or normalize in data.
critical_code_review_comments: plottoSymbols.buildRegex uses '(?:syms)X?' — safe here because AX/BX/X are also explicit designations in plotto.json, so map lookups hit directly and baseDesc's 'mysterious ' fallback is only used for other bases (e.g. A-2X). Verified no infinite recursion in describe() for X-variants.
Cast chips intentionally show the raw canonical token (e.g. 'BX') next to its English label; step text contains no raw X symbols — matches spec.

verified_results.browse_3_level_tree: PASS - category-Love and Courtship / category-Married Life / category-Enterprise visible; click Enterprise -> subcategory-Personal Limitations (96); click -> heading-Seeking Against Difficulties to Realize a Cherished Ideal (17); click -> exactly 17 conflict cards incl conflict-card-1107a and conflict-card-1107b; caption reads '17 conflicts in Enterprise · Personal Limitations · Seeking Against Difficulties to Realize a Cherished Ideal'; zero console errors.
verified_results.heading_filter_accuracy: PASS - all 17 cards match backend GET /api/plotto/conflicts?category=Enterprise&subcategory=Personal Limitations&heading=... (total 17, ids 1107a..1121).
verified_results.x_mystery_plain_english: PASS - added #19a (BX) and #20a (X) from Browse, navigated in-app to /builder: presentation-cast shows 'BX -> Mysterious female person, or one of unusual character' and 'X -> Inanimate object, an object of mystery, an uncertain quantity'; present-step-19a renders '...by marrying mysterious female person, or one of unusual character.' and present-step-20a renders '...buy an object, inanimate object, an object of mystery, an uncertain quantity, ...' — no raw AX/BX in step text.
verified_results.characters_page: PASS - /characters lists AX/BX/X with mysterious/uncertain-quantity descriptions, no crash; ClauseText chip for BX on /conflict/19a renders and hovers without error.
verified_results.node_unit_check: renderPlainEnglish/resolveCast/extractSymbols run clean on BX/X/AX texts (no infinite loop, correct English).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://story-builder-248.preview.emergentagent.com. Playwright sessions are fresh contexts, so localStorage draft ('plotto_draft_v1') does NOT survive between tool invocations — add conflicts and check /builder in the SAME script (in-app sidebar 'Plot Builder' link is more reliable than page.goto). Anonymous pages log two harmless 401s (/api/auth/me). Not retested this round: dice, library/auth, A·B·C clauses, mobile viewport.
rca_of_the_issue: First builder run appeared to fail (final-presentation not found) purely because page.goto after the adds hit a slow/aborted navigation in a cold preview; re-run in a single session with in-app navigation passed. No product defect.
